backend:run.description: Start the Spring Boot backend (requires Postgres + Redis already running via docker compose)

backend:build.description: Compile the backend and surface any errors, without starting the server

frontend:run.description: Start the Angular dev server on http://localhost:4200

frontend:build.description: Production build of the Angular app, surfaces TypeScript errors

infra:logs.description: Tail logs from Postgres and Redis containers

db:psql.command: docker exec -it $(docker compose ps -q postgres) psql -U tg_user -d transactionguard
db:psql.description: Open a psql shell into the running Postgres container

db:redis-cli.command: docker exec -it $(docker compose ps -q redis) redis-cli
db:redis-cli.description: Open a redis-cli shell into the running Redis container
